ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 85:15 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous black mass spanning 80% of surface area. Distinct white mottling at the far left distal tip. A solid white patch on the right distal tip containing parallel black linear striations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 40-45 degree internal pixel angle and a depth of roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with pixel amplitudes ranging from 10-30 pixels, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary across the entire trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitting on the upper margins of both lobes, tapering to rounded lateral terminations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (1-4 pixels in diameter) scattered across the low-intensity central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent intersecting linear white pixel disruptions on the left lobe forming a cross-hatch pattern, with additional diagonal linear marks near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, irregular V-shaped notch/indentation on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe, independent of the median notch, indicating physical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Rhythmic, parallel horizontal dark line patterns (striations) within the high-intensity white patch on the right fluke tip.
